<script defer id="gh-v6-rolling-recovery">
(()=>{'use strict';
 const WATCH=new Set(['gh1200_state','gh_fusion_v5_state']);
 const BK='gh_master_rollback_v6';
 const rawSet=Storage.prototype.setItem;
 function read(){try{const a=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(BK)||'[]');return Array.isArray(a)?a:[]}catch(_){return []}}
 function push(key,data){if(!data)return;try{let a=read();const last=a[0];if(last&&last.key===key&&last.data===data)return;a.unshift({key,at:new Date().toISOString(),data});a=a.slice(0,12);rawSet.call(localStorage,BK,JSON.stringify(a))}catch(_){}}
 Storage.prototype.setItem=function(key,val){try{if(WATCH.has(String(key))){const prev=this.getItem(key);if(prev&&prev!==String(val))push(String(key),prev)}}catch(_){}return rawSet.call(this,key,val)};
 window.GH_MASTER_RECOVERY_V6=()=>read().map((x,i)=>({index:i,key:x.key,at:x.at,size:x.data?.length||0}));
 window.GH_MASTER_RESTORE_V6=(index=0)=>{const a=read(),x=a[index];if(!x)return false;rawSet.call(localStorage,x.key,x.data);return true};
})();
</script>

#startPage>.gh-v68-intro,#security>.gh-v68-intro,#support>.gh-v68-intro,#gate>.gh-v68-intro,#points>.gh-v68-intro,#ranking>.gh-v68-intro,#how>.gh-v68-intro,#rules>.gh-v68-intro,#save>.gh-v68-intro{
 position:relative;overflow:hidden;margin:10px 0 12px;padding:21px 17px 19px;min-height:136px;border:1px solid var(--gh68-line);border-radius:23px;
 background:radial-gradient(circle at 91% 13%,rgba(253,198,88,.20),transparent 37%),linear-gradient(125deg,#24200e,#0c1319 65%,#070a10);
 box-shadow:0 12px 28px #000a,inset 0 1px rgba(255,232,180,.13);
}
.gh-v68-intro::before{content:"";position:absolute;right:-22px;top:-38px;width:164px;height:164px;pointer-events:none;opacity:.26;border:1px solid #d5aa53;border-radius:50%;box-shadow:0 0 0 18px rgba(224,182,96,.04),0 0 0 42px rgba(224,182,96,.035)}
.gh-v68-intro small{display:block;position:relative;color:#f2cb76;font:800 10px/1.4 Georgia,serif;letter-spacing:.13em}
.gh-v68-intro strong{display:block;position:relative;margin-top:8px;color:#fff0be;font:800 clamp(22px,5.8vw,33px)/1.35 "Noto Serif JP","Yu Mincho",serif}
.gh-v68-intro p{position:relative;margin:7px 0 0;color:#ddd7c7;font-size:12px;line-height:1.7}
#startPage .ban,#rules #formalRules .ban{border:1px solid rgba(255,120,103,.68);border-radius:19px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#39160f,#191017 70%);box-shadow:0 9px 23px #0008;padding:16px}
#startPage .ban strong,#rules #formalRules .ban strong{color:#fff0d8;font-size:clamp(16px,4vw,22px)}
#startPage .ban p,#rules #formalRules .ban p{color:#ffd9d2;font-size:12px;line-height:1.8}
#startPage .twoCol,#support .infoGrid,#gate .gateGrid,#points .infoGrid,#how .infoGrid,#rules .infoGrid,#save .infoGrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:11px}
#startPage .formCard,#startPage .saveBox,#security>.notice,#security #gh2351Security,#support .notice,#support .infoCard,#gate>.notice,#gate .gateCard,#points .infoCard,#ranking .notice,#ranking .infoCard,#how .infoCard,#rules .infoCard,#save .saveBox,#save .infoCard{
 margin:0 0 10px;min-width:0;padding:16px;border:1px solid rgba(231,186,91,.37);border-radius:19px;
 background:var(--gh68-panel);color:#ede6d6;box-shadow:0 8px 22px #0007,inset 0 1px rgba(255,232,166,.08);
}
#startPage .twoCol .formCard,#support .infoGrid .infoCard,#gate .gateGrid .gateCard,#points .infoGrid .infoCard,#how .infoGrid .infoCard,#rules .infoGrid .infoCard,#save .infoGrid .infoCard{margin-bottom:0}
#startPage h2,#support h3,#gate h3,#points h3,#how h3,#rules h3,#save h2,#save h3{color:#ffe3a3;font:800 clamp(16px,4vw,21px)/1.4 "Noto Serif JP","Yu Mincho",sans-serif;margin:0 0 9px}
#startPage .formCard p,#startPage .saveBox p,#support .notice,#support .infoCard p,#gate>.notice,#gate .gateCard p,#points .infoCard p,#ranking .notice,#ranking .infoCard p,#how .infoCard p,#rules .infoCard p,#save .saveBox p,#save .infoCard p{
 margin:0 0 10px;color:#d6e0e0;font-size:12px;line-height:1.8;overflow-wrap:anywhere;
}
#startPage .wideGold,#save .wideGold,#security #gh2351PolicyOpen{min-height:52px;border-radius:15px;border:1px solid rgba(255,224,147,.75);background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ffedac,#f3c957 56%,#bc781a);color:#30200a;font-weight:900;box-shadow:0 9px 22px #0008}
#security #gh2351Security{margin-top:10px}
#security #gh2351Security small{color:#f0c96b;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.09em}
#security #gh2351Security strong{display:block;margin-top:7px;color:#ffeac0;font:800 clamp(16px,4vw,23px)/1.45 "Noto Serif JP","Yu Mincho",serif}
#security #gh2351Security p{margin:8px 0 13px;color:#dce0dc;font-size:12px;line-height:1.9;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
#security #gh2351PolicyOpen{width:100%;min-height:54px;font-size:clamp(12px,3.5vw,16px);white-space:normal}
#support #supportGrid{display:grid;gap:10px;margin-top:12px}
#support #supportGrid .card{min-width:0;border:1px solid rgba(231,186,91,.36);border-radius:18px;background:#0a121b}
#support #supportGrid button{min-height:48px}
#gate .gateCard small{display:block;color:#e5c476;font-size:11px;line-height:1.7}
#points>.status{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:7px;overflow:visible;background:none;border:0;margin:0 0 12px}
#points>.status>div{min-width:0;padding:14px 8px;border:1px solid var(--gh68-line);border-radius:16px;background:var(--gh68-panel);text-align:center}
#points>.status small{display:block;color:#d7bc83;font-size:11px}
#points>.status b{color:#fff0b9;font-size:clamp(16px,4vw,23px);overflow-wrap:anywhere}
#ranking .ranking{display:grid;gap:10px;margin-top:10px}
#ranking .ranking>.row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:48px minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:10px;align-items:center;padding:16px;border-radius:19px;border:1px solid var(--gh68-line);background:var(--gh68-panel);min-width:0}
#ranking .ranking>.row strong{color:#fff0b9;font-size:17px}
#ranking .ranking>.row span{overflow-wrap:anywhere}
#rules #formalRules{margin-bottom:12px}
#save #saveStatus{margin-top:10px;padding:12px;border:1px solid rgba(230,185,87,.25);border-radius:13px;background:#08121c;color:#d7e8e7!important;font-size:12px!important;line-height:1.75;white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
@media (max-width:600px){
 #startPage .twoCol,#support .infoGrid,#gate .gateGrid,#points .infoGrid,#how .infoGrid,#rules .infoGrid,#save .infoGrid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
 #points>.status{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}
 #startPage>.header,#security>.header,#support>.header,#gate>.header,#points>.header,#ranking>.header,#how>.header,#rules>.header,#save>.header{padding:12px;gap:10px}
 .gh-v68-intro{padding:18px 14px}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){#startPage *,#security *,#support *,#gate *,#points *,#ranking *,#how *,#rules *,#save *{scroll-behavior:auto}}
</style>

<style id="gh-v69-home-empty-state">
/* 表示専用の限定修正。空の通知枠のみ隠し、データ挿入時は元通り見える。 */
#home #ghV29HomeBonus:empty,
#home #ghV31HomeProgress:empty,
#home #ghV33HomeBonus:empty,
#home #ghV30SkillOdds:empty{
 display:none!important;
 margin:0!important;
 padding:0!important;
 border:0!important;
 min-height:0!important;
 box-shadow:none!important;
}
/* レース状況がある時だけ、ホームのカード類と同じ黒金パネルにする。 */
#home #ghV29HomeBonus:not(:empty),
#home #ghV31HomeProgress:not(:empty),
#home #ghV33HomeBonus:not(:empty),
#home #ghV30SkillOdds:not(:empty){
 color:#e9e1cf;
 font-size:11px;
 line-height:1.75;
 border:1px solid rgba(231,186,91,.40);
 border-radius:17px;
 background:linear-gradient(145deg,#241a0c,#0c131a 65%,#080d12);
 box-shadow:0 9px 24px #0008,inset 0 1px rgba(255,227,164,.07);
}
#home #ghV29HomeBonus b,#home #ghV31HomeProgress b,
#home #ghV33HomeBonus b,#home #ghV30SkillOdds b{color:#ffe2a1}
/* V64 の旧コードで入った重複のうち、同じ案内文の追加 div だけ非表示。 */
#home #betSlips .emptyBet > div[style*="margin-top"]{display:none!important}
/* オッズ照合エラーを、投票がないだけの案内と取り違えない。 */
#home .oddsCards .emptyBet::after{content:none!important;display:none!important}
/* 空欄への補助文は投票履歴だけに表示し、他の警告表示に拡散させない。 */
#home #betSlips .emptyBet::after{content:"馬を選んで投票を追加してください";display:block;margin-top:6px;color:#c7ad75;font-size:11px}
</style>
<style id="gh-v71-race-shortcuts-style">
#home .betPanel,#home .odds{scroll-margin-top:88px}
#home .gh-v71-jump{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:7px;width:100%;min-height:48px;padding:10px 14px;border:1px solid rgba(235,190,102,.58);border-radius:16px;background:linear-gradient(120deg,#422906,#261a09 45%,#0b1720 100%);color:#ffe7ac;font-size:14px;font-weight:900;line-height:1.4;letter-spacing:.01em;box-shadow:inset 0 1px rgba(255,233,174,.1),0 8px 20px #0006;touch-action:manipulation}
#home .gh-v71-jump small{font-size:10px;color:#d9c5a0;font-weight:700}
#home .gh-v71-jump span[aria-hidden]{font-size:20px;line-height:1}
#home .gh-v71-jump-to-bet{margin-top:10px;box-shadow:inset 0 1px rgba(255,233,174,.16),0 7px 18px #0007}
#home .gh-v71-jump-to-horses{background:linear-gradient(120deg,#0b1720,#231a0a);margin:0 0 2px;min-height:44px}
#home .gh-v71-jump:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #ffe8ab;outline-offset:3px}
#home .gh-v71-jump:active{filter:brightness(1.22)}
@media(max-width:380px){#home .gh-v71-jump small{flex:0 0 100%;text-align:center}#home .gh-v71-jump{gap:3px}}
</style>

<style id="gh-v72-gold-outline">
:root{--gh72-gold-main:#ffe29a;--gh72-gold-deep:#f0c861;--gh72-outline:#160d03;--gh72-outline-soft:rgba(0,0,0,.55);}
/* 上品な金文字補強 */
.brand,.raceInfo h2,.sectionTitle h3,.header h1,#login .gh-v66-login-header h1,#login .gh-v66-login-lead strong,#home .raceInfo h2,#home .sectionTitle h3,#home .count b,#home .count span,#home .status b{
  color:var(--gh72-gold-main)!important;
  -webkit-text-stroke:.6px rgba(16,9,2,.72);
  text-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.65),0 0 8px rgba(255,193,74,.10),1px 0 0 var(--gh72-outline-soft),-1px 0 0 var(--gh72-outline-soft),0 1px 0 var(--gh72-outline-soft),0 -1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.45);
}
.feature b,.odd,.oddNum,#home .oddNum,#home .horseTitleLine b,#home .betSlip strong,#home .pop,#home .count small,#home .gh-v64-home-meta .gh-v64-card-title{
  color:var(--gh72-gold-main)!important;
  -webkit-text-stroke:.45px rgba(18,10,2,.68);
  text-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.62),1px 0 0 rgba(0,0,0,.4),-1px 0 0 rgba(0,0,0,.4),0 0 6px rgba(255,190,60,.08);
}
/* Gold残高・数値を締める */
.status b,#home>.status b,.feature b{letter-spacing:.01em}
.status small,#home>.status small{color:#d3b269!important;text-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.38)}
/* 主ボタンは金背景＋濃い文字で押しやすく */
.betBtn,.wideGold,#home .count button,#home .betBtn,#login .wideGold{
  border:1px solid rgba(61,31,0,.68)!important;
  box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.38), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,245,204,.45), inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(96,50,0,.35)!important;
}
.betBtn,.wideGold,#home .count button,#home .betBtn,#login .wideGold,.betTypes button.on,.chip.on,#home .betTypes button.on,#home .chip.on,#home .horsePick.on{
  color:#2b1600!important;
  text-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(255,240,190,.55),0 -1px 0 rgba(73,42,0,.12);
}
/* 非選択の金文字系も少し締める */
.goldPick.on,.count button,.betTypes button.on,.chip.on,#home .betTypes button.on,#home .chip.on,#home .horsePick.on,#home .horsePick .seq{font-weight:1000}
/* オッズ表示を少し主役化 */
.odd,.oddNum,#home .oddNum{font-size:clamp(18px,4.9vw,22px);font-weight:1000;letter-spacing:.01em}
#home .horseOdds>div>div:last-child,.horseOdds .oddNum{line-height:1.05}
/* タイマー強化 */
.count b,#home .count b{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;letter-spacing:.01em}
.count small,#home .count small{font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.05em}
/* 下ナビの選択中も少し締める */
nav button.active, .bottomNav button.active, .tabbar button.active{ text-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.6),0 0 6px rgba(255,196,76,.12); }
/* 戻るボタンや補助の金文字 */
.back,#login .gh-v66-login-header .back,#home .ghV49Utility .secondaryBtn{
  color:#fff0ce;
  text-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.62);
}
/* 見出しの金文字が細く見えすぎる箇所の補正 */
#home .gh-v59-home-lead h2,#home .raceInfo h2,.raceInfo h2,.header h1{font-weight:1000;letter-spacing:.01em}
@media(max-width:520px){
  .brand{ -webkit-text-stroke:.5px rgba(16,9,2,.72);}
  .odd,.oddNum,#home .oddNum{font-size:20px}
}
</style>


<style id="gh-v74-runners-readable">
/* 読みにくかった出走馬カードだけ改善。出走数・オッズ算出・BET処理は変更しない。 */
#home .oddsHorseCard{row-gap:9px;column-gap:8px;padding:12px 11px;border-radius:17px;align-items:center}

#home .oddsHorseCard .miniStat i{height:7px;min-width:9px;background:#13222a}
#home .oddsHorseCard .horseOdds{min-width:0;justify-content:flex-end;gap:13px}
#home .oddsHorseCard .horseOdds small{font-size:10px;line-height:1.4}
#home .oddsHorseCard .horseNoBox{flex-shrink:0}
@media(max-width:390px){
 #home .oddsHorseCard{padding:10px 9px;grid-template-columns:36px minmax(0,1fr) 77px!important;column-gap:6px}
 #home .oddsHorseCard .horseNoBox{height:44px;font-size:21px}

}

<style id="gh-premium-cinema-isolated">

:root{--gh-premium-gold:#f4d58a;--gh-premium-edge:rgba(245,197,98,.55);--gh-premium-black:#050406}

.app{background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% -8%,rgba(116,79,29,.19),transparent 53%)}
#home .hero{border:1px solid var(--gh-premium-edge);box-shadow:0 0 0 1px #140f08,0 22px 60px #000c,inset 0 1px #ffebbd35;filter:saturate(1.05)}

#home .menu button.primary,#home .betBtn{border-color:#ffe2a1;background:linear-gradient(165deg,#fff2b7 0%,#d7a84d 39%,#6f410c 100%);color:#201001}

#gacha .gh-v61-gacha-hero{min-height:190px;border:1px solid #e0ba6b;border-radius:20px;background:linear-gradient(110deg,#040405e8 10%,#0908078c 64%,#0a080466),var(--gh-v61-horse-art) center 44%/cover;box-shadow:0 22px 38px #000b,inset 0 0 28px #d3a64a1f}

#gacha .gachaStage{position:relative;isolation:isolate;overflow:hidden;min-height:480px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;border:2px solid #a97b31;border-radius:27px;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 56%,#5135198a 0%,#131013 41%,#040407 84%);box-shadow:0 24px 60px #000c,0 0 0 1px #fff1b122,inset 0 0 82px #dfad4514}
#gacha .gachaStage:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;animation:none!important;background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,transparent 0 17%,#fcd17c4b 17.25% 17.65%,#1c1205 17.9% 18.6%),linear-gradient(90deg,#211609 0 5%,transparent 9% 91%,#211609 95% 100%);opacity:.68}
#gacha .gachaStage:after{content:"GOLDEN HORSE  ·  THE LEGEND BEGINS";position:absolute;z-index:1;left:10%;right:10%;bottom:95px;padding:8px 4px;text-align:center;letter-spacing:.2em;font:700 9px/1.4 Georgia,serif;color:#ffe6a4;border-top:1px solid #cca04f;border-bottom:1px solid #7e5319;background:#060506c9;pointer-events:none}
#gacha .gachaStage.artHorse{background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 65%,#a8762728 0%,#18100d 49%,#030305 88%)}
#gacha .gachaStage.artHorse:before{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#d8a34a44 0 3px,transparent 3px 70%,#d0a04c55 70% 73%,transparent 73%),repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,#2b1d0a 0 2%,#dbad56ab 2% 2.65%,#070609 3% 15.9%),linear-gradient(#080607,#080607);opacity:.62;mask-image:linear-gradient(#000,#000 75%,transparent 92%)}

#gacha .gachaStage.artJockey:before{background:conic-gradient(from 156deg at 50% -3%,transparent 0deg,#ffe7a441 18deg,transparent 33deg 325deg,#ffe7a441 341deg,transparent 360deg),radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 85%,#e7c16e51,transparent 52%);opacity:1}

<script defer id="gh2330-nav-rescue">
(()=>{
  function rescuePage(id){
    const target=document.getElementById(id);
    if(!target)return false;
    document.querySelectorAll('.screen').forEach(el=>el.classList.remove('active'));
    target.classList.add('active');
    try{window.scrollTo({top:0,left:0,behavior:'instant'})}catch(_){try{window.scrollTo(0,0)}catch(__){}}
    return true;
  }
  document.addEventListener('click',ev=>{
    const el=ev.target&&ev.target.closest?ev.target.closest('[data-page]'):null;
    if(!el)return;
    const id=el.getAttribute('data-page');
    if(!id||!document.getElementById(id))return;
    // Rescue navigation runs before the large game script. The normal handler may still render content afterwards.
    rescuePage(id);
  },true);
  window.__gh2330RescuePage=rescuePage;
})();
</script>

<section id="login" class="screen subpage"><div class="header gh-v66-login-header"><button class="back" data-page="home">← 戻る</button><h1>マイログイン / 新規登録</h1></div><div class="gh-v66-login-lead"><small>MEMBER ACCESS / SECURE ENTRY</small><strong>会員登録もログインも、同じ黒金シネマの世界観で。</strong><p>携帯番号・SMS認証・端末確認で、会員データとGoldを安全に守ります。</p></div><div class="twoCol gh-v66-login-grid"><div class="formCard gh-v66-auth-card"><h2>新規登録</h2><p class="smsLead">携帯番号へSMS認証番号を送信 → 6桁番号を入力 → 初回パスワード設定。</p><input id="newPhone" inputmode="tel" autocomplete="tel" placeholder="携帯番号 09012345678"><button class="wideGold" id="smsRequestBtn">SMS認証番号を送る</button><div class="gh-v66-provider-note"><b>SMS認証について</b><span>SMS認証にはSupabase Auth側の電話認証・SMS配信設定が必要です。赤い案内が出た場合、接続設定だけでなく入力内容・送信制限も確認してください。</span></div><div id="smsStep" class="smsStep"><input id="smsCode" inputmode="numeric" autocomplete="one-time-code" maxlength="6" placeholder="SMS認証番号 6桁"><input id="newNickname" autocomplete="nickname" placeholder="ニックネーム"><input id="newPass" type="password" autocomplete="new-password" placeholder="初回パスワード 8文字以上"><input id="newPass2" type="password" autocomplete="new-password" placeholder="パスワード確認"><button class="wideGold" id="registerBtn">SMS認証して新規登録</button></div><div id="smsStatus" class="authStatus">SMS認証番号を送信してください。</div></div><div class="formCard gh-v66-auth-card"><h2>マイログイン</h2><p class="smsLead">登録した携帯番号＋パスワードでログイン。</p><input id="loginPhone" inputmode="tel" autocomplete="tel" placeholder="携帯番号"><input id="loginPass" type="password" autocomplete="current-password" placeholder="パスワード"><button class="wideGold" id="loginBtn">ログイン</button><div id="loginStatus" class="authStatus">未ログイン</div><div class="gh-v66-login-help"><b>ログインできない時</b><span>携帯番号の入力違い、SMS認証未完了、または端末保存未実行が原因のことがあります。ホームの「端末保存」を押してから再度お試しください。</span></div></div></div><div class="notice authNotice"><b>スマホ対応</b><br>iPhone Safari / Android Chrome の縦画面で操作しやすい入力サイズに調整。SMSの実送信は正規認証サーバー接続時に行います。</div></section>

<section id="how" class="screen subpage"><div class="header"><button class="back" data-page="home">← 戻る</button><h1>基本ガイド</h1></div><div class="gh-v68-intro" aria-label="はじめてでも、迷わない。"><small>GUIDE / HOW TO PLAY</small><strong>はじめてでも、迷わない。</strong><p>投票からレース・育成・保存までを確認できます。</p></div><div class="infoGrid" id="howGrid"></div></section><section id="rules" class="screen subpage"><div class="header"><button class="back" data-page="home">← 戻る</button><h1>禁止事項</h1></div><div class="gh-v68-intro" aria-label="ルールを守って楽しむ。"><small>RULES / FAIR PLAY</small><strong>ルールを守って楽しむ。</strong><p>店内ゲーム禁止など、大切な決まりを確認してください。</p></div><div id="formalRules"></div><div class="infoGrid" id="rulesGrid"></div></section><section id="save" class="screen subpage"><div class="header"><button class="back" data-page="home">← 戻る</button><h1>ゲーム終了保存</h1></div><div class="gh-v68-intro" aria-label="積み重ねた記録を、大切に。"><small>SAVE / YOUR LEGEND</small><strong>積み重ねた記録を、大切に。</strong><p>データの保存状況を確認しながら、次のレースへ。</p></div><div class="saveBox"><h2>最終データを保存</h2><p>Gold・マイホース・マイ騎手・カード・装備・応募履歴・レース数・設定を保存。ログイン中はSupabaseクラウド保存、通信失敗時は端末保存も残して二重化します。</p><button class="wideGold" id="saveBtn">ゲーム終了保存</button><pre id="saveStatus" style="white-space:pre-wrap;color:#8fb7ca;font-size:11px"></pre></div><div class="infoGrid"><div class="infoCard"><h3>別スマホ復元</h3><p>同じ会員でログイン後、クラウド保存データを読み込んで復元する設計。</p></div><div class="infoCard"><h3>復旧保護</h3><p>復元失敗時に勝手に初期化しない。最新保存と履歴を残して復旧可能にします。</p></div></div></section></div>

  <filter id="${id}s"><feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="12"/></filter>
 </defs>
 <rect width="720" height="900" fill="url(#${id})"/>
 <circle cx="360" cy="300" r="190" fill="${glow}" opacity=".12" filter="url(#${id}s)"/>

  <path d="M458 179 L520 245" fill="none" stroke="#d9c49a" stroke-width="7"/>

}

const GH_STATE_API='https://example.invalid/functions/v1/gh-state-v1';
let cloudSaveTimer=0,cloudBusy=false,cloudLastSaved='';
function setCloudBadge(msg,type=''){const e=$('#cloudStatusBadge');if(!e)return;e.textContent=msg;e.className='cloudStatusBadge '+type}
function localSave(){localStorage.setItem('gh_guest_isolated_v2_state',JSON.stringify(state))}
function save(){localSave();scheduleCloudSave()}
function scheduleCloudSave(){
 const token=localStorage.getItem('gh_session_token');if(!token){setCloudBadge('☁ 端末保存');return}
 clearTimeout(cloudSaveTimer);setCloudBadge('☁ 保存待ち','sync');cloudSaveTimer=setTimeout(()=>cloudStateSave(false),1400)
}
async function cloudStateRequest(payload){
 const r=await fetch(GH_STATE_API,{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify(payload)});
 const j=await r.json().catch(()=>({}));if(!r.ok||j.ok===false)throw new Error(j.error||'state_error');return j.data??j
}
async function cloudStateSave(manual=true){
 const token=localStorage.getItem('gh_session_token');if(!token){if(manual)toast('ログインするとクラウド保存できます');setCloudBadge('☁ 端末保存');return false}
 if(cloudBusy)return false;cloudBusy=true;setCloudBadge('☁ クラウド保存中','sync');
 try{
   const d=await cloudStateRequest({action:'save',session_token:token,state,client_build:'FRIEND-V111-LIVE-COMMENTARY'});
   cloudLastSaved=d?.saved_at||new Date().toISOString();localStorage.setItem('gh_cloud_saved_at',cloudLastSaved);setCloudBadge('☁ クラウド保存済み','ok');if(manual)toast('クラウド保存 完了');return true
 }catch(e){setCloudBadge('☁ 保存失敗','err');if(manual)toast(e.message==='invalid_session'?'ログイン期限が切れています':'クラウド保存に失敗しました');return false}
 finally{cloudBusy=false}
}
async function cloudStateLoad({silent=false}={}){
 const token=localStorage.getItem('gh_session_token');if(!token)return false;setCloudBadge('☁ 復旧データ確認中','sync');
 try{
   const d=await cloudStateRequest({action:'load',session_token:token});
   if(d?.has_state&&d.state&&typeof d.state==='object'){
     state=d.state;localSave();renderAll();setCloudBadge('☁ クラウド復旧済み','ok');if(!silent)toast('クラウドの最新データを復旧しました');return true
   }
   await cloudStateSave(false);setCloudBadge('☁ 初回バックアップ済み','ok');return false
 }catch(e){setCloudBadge('☁ 復旧確認失敗','err');if(!silent)toast('クラウド復旧確認に失敗しました');return false}
}

function toast(t){const e=$('#toast');e.textContent=t;e.classList.add('on');clearTimeout(e.t);e.t=setTimeout(()=>e.classList.remove('on'),2200)}
function page(id){if(GH_DEMO&&id==='startPage')id='home';const target=$('#'+id);if(!target){toast('画面を読み込めませんでした');return false}try{window.__gh2330RescuePage?window.__gh2330RescuePage(id):($$('.screen').forEach(s=>s.classList.remove('active')),target.classList.add('active'),scrollTo(0,0))}catch(e){$$('.screen').forEach(s=>s.classList.remove('active'));target.classList.add('active')}try{if(id==='horse')renderHorse();else if(id==='jockey')renderJockey();else if(id==='gacha')renderGachaCollection();else if(id==='cards')renderCards();else if(id==='support')renderSupport();else if(id==='seat')renderSeats();else if(id==='ranking')renderRanking();else if(id==='campaign')renderCampaign();else if(id==='how')renderHow();else if(id==='rules')renderRules();else if(id==='home')renderHome()}catch(e){console.error('page render',id,e);toast('画面の一部を再読み込みしました')}return true}
function ensureAudio(){try{const C=window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext;if(!audio)audio=new C();audio.resume?.()}catch(e){}}
document.addEventListener('pointerdown',ensureAudio,{passive:true});
function tone(f,d=.12,type='sine',v=.035){if(!sound)return;ensureAudio();if(!audio)return;const o=audio.createOscillator(),g=audio.createGain();o.type=type;o.frequency.value=f;g.gain.value=v;o.connect(g);g.connect(audio.destination);o.start();g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,audio.currentTime+d);o.stop(audio.currentTime+d)}
let bettingBgmTimer=0,gallopTimer=0,audioUnlocked=false;
function startBettingBgm(){
 if(!sound||running||bettingBgmTimer)return;ensureAudio();if(!audio)return;
 audioUnlocked=true;
 const playBar=()=>{
  if(!sound||running)return;
  const root=[110,123.47,98,130.81][Math.floor(Date.now()/6000)%4];
  tone(root,.62,'sine',.026);tone(root*2,.34,'triangle',.014);
  setTimeout(()=>tone(root*1.5,.24,'sine',.012),420);
  setTimeout(()=>tone(root*2.5,.18,'triangle',.010),880);
 };
 playBar();bettingBgmTimer=setInterval(playBar,1500);
}
function stopBettingBgm(){clearInterval(bettingBgmTimer);bettingBgmTimer=0}
function startGallopLoop(){
 clearInterval(gallopTimer);
 gallopTimer=setInterval(()=>{
  if(!running||!sound)return;
  const fast=raceState?.phaseIndex>=5;
  const base=fast?92:78;
  tone(base,.055,'sine',fast?.055:.04);
  setTimeout(()=>tone(base*.78,.045,'triangle',fast?.038:.028),fast?78:102);
  if(Math.random()<.45)noise(70,fast?.018:.012);
 },raceState?.phaseIndex>=5?160:220);
}
function stopGallopLoop(){clearInterval(gallopTimer);gallopTimer=0}
function crowdSwell(power=1){
 if(!sound)return;ensureAudio();
 noise(800,.018*power);[180,240,320].forEach((f,i)=>setTimeout(()=>tone(f,.22,'triangle',.018*power),i*65));
}
document.addEventListener('pointerdown',()=>{if(!audioUnlocked){audioUnlocked=true;startBettingBgm();toast('🔊 BGM・音響 ON')}} ,{passive:true,once:true});
let renderQuality='MID', raceCanvas=null, raceCtx=null, raceRAF=0, raceParticles=[], raceCanvasOn=false, shakePower=0;
function detectRenderQuality(){
 try{
  const cores=navigator.hardwareConcurrency||4;
  const mem=navigator.deviceMemory||4;
  const saveData=!!navigator.connection?.saveData;
  const px=(screen.width||390)*(screen.height||844)*(window.devicePixelRatio||1);
  if(saveData||cores<=4||mem<=3||px>6000000)return 'LITE';
  if(cores>=8&&mem>=6)return 'HIGH';
  return 'MID';
 }catch(e){return 'MID'}
}
renderQuality=detectRenderQuality();
function uiSound(kind='tap'){
 if(!sound)return;
 const map={
  tap:[[540,.045,'sine',.026],[760,.05,'triangle',.018]],
  select:[[620,.05,'triangle',.03],[920,.07,'sine',.02]],
  back:[[420,.055,'sine',.025],[300,.07,'triangle',.018]],
  confirm:[[740,.06,'triangle',.035],[1110,.09,'sine',.025]],
  card:[[330,.06,'sine',.02],[660,.08,'triangle',.028]],
  menu:[[500,.04,'sine',.02],[820,.06,'triangle',.02]]
 };
 (map[kind]||map.tap).forEach((n,i)=>setTimeout(()=>tone(n[0],n[1],n[2],n[3]),i*40));
 navigator.vibrate?.(kind==='confirm'?18:8);
}
document.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{
 const b=e.target.closest('button,[data-page],[data-tab],[data-pick],[data-seat],[data-equip]');
 if(!b)return;
 b.classList.add('uiPressed');setTimeout(()=>b.classList.remove('uiPressed'),120);
 const txt=(b.textContent||'').trim();
 if(txt.includes('戻る')||b.classList.contains('back'))uiSound('back');
 else if(txt.includes('投票')||txt.includes('保存')||txt.includes('応募')||txt.includes('登録')||txt.includes('ログイン'))uiSound('confirm');
 else if(b.matches('[data-pick],.chip,.goldPick,[data-seat]'))uiSound('select');
 else if(txt.includes('カード')||txt.includes('ガチャ'))uiSound('card');
 else uiSound('menu');
},{passive:true});
function resizeRaceCanvas(){
 raceCanvas=document.getElementById('raceCanvas'); if(!raceCanvas)return;
 raceCtx=raceCanvas.getContext('2d',{alpha:true});
 const dpr=Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio||1,renderQuality==='HIGH'?1.65:renderQuality==='MID'?1.3:1);
 raceCanvas.width=Math.max(1,Math.floor(innerWidth*dpr));raceCanvas.height=Math.max(1,Math.floor(innerHeight*dpr));
 raceCanvas.style.width=innerWidth+'px';raceCanvas.style.height=innerHeight+'px';
 raceCtx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);
 const q=document.getElementById('qualityBadge');if(q)q.textContent='画質 '+renderQuality;
}
window.addEventListener('resize',()=>{if(raceCanvasOn)resizeRaceCanvas()},{passive:true});
function spawnRaceParticle(x,y,type='dust',amount=1){
 const cap=renderQuality==='HIGH'?260:renderQuality==='MID'?150:85;
 for(let i=0;i<amount&&raceParticles.length<cap;i++){
  const speed=type==='dust'?1.2+Math.random()*2.5:3+Math.random()*5;
  raceParticles.push({x,y,vx:(Math.random()-.8)*speed,vy:(Math.random()-.5)*speed,life:1,size:type==='dust'?3+Math.random()*7:1+Math.random()*2,type});
 }
}
function runnerCenter(id){
 const el=document.getElementById('runner'+id),rs=document.getElementById('raceScreen');
 if(!el||!rs)return null;const a=el.getBoundingClientRect(),b=rs.getBoundingClientRect();
 return {x:a.left-b.left+a.width*.28,y:a.top-b.top+a.height*.72};
}
function drawCanvasTrack(){
 if(!raceCtx)return;const c=raceCtx,w=innerWidth,h=innerHeight;c.clearRect(0,0,w,h);
 c.save();
 if(shakePower>0){c.translate((Math.random()-.5)*shakePower,(Math.random()-.5)*shakePower);shakePower*=.88;if(shakePower<.3)shakePower=0}
 const horizon=h*.34;c.globalAlpha=.22;c.strokeStyle='#6ee8ff';c.lineWidth=1;
 for(let i=0;i<7;i++){const yy=horizon+(i/7)*(h*.34);c.beginPath();c.moveTo(0,yy);c.lineTo(w,yy+18);c.stroke()}
 c.globalAlpha=.18;const grad=c.createLinearGradient(0,0,w,0);grad.addColorStop(0,'transparent');grad.addColorStop(.5,'#ffe47a');grad.addColorStop(1,'transparent');c.fillStyle=grad;c.fillRect(0,h*.62,w,2);
 if(typeof weatherState!=='undefined' && ['rain','heavy','thunder'].includes(weatherState.key)){
  c.strokeStyle='rgba(210,245,255,'+(weatherState.key==='heavy'||weatherState.key==='thunder'?.40:.24)+')';
  c.lineWidth=1;const n=renderQuality==='HIGH'?75:renderQuality==='MID'?45:24;
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const x=(i*83+performance.now()*.45)% (w+80)-40,y=(i*47+performance.now()*.72)%h;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(x,y);c.lineTo(x-9,y+25);c.stroke()}
 }
 if(document.getElementById('raceScreen')?.classList.contains('sprint')){
  c.globalAlpha=.28;c.strokeStyle='#ffffff';const n=renderQuality==='HIGH'?35:renderQuality==='MID'?22:12;
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const y=(i*41+performance.now()*.11)%h;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(w*.65,y);c.lineTo(w,y-16);c.stroke()}
 }
 if(running){
  for(let id=1;id<=7;id++){if(raceState?.scratch===id)continue;const p=runnerCenter(id);if(p&&Math.random()<(renderQuality==='HIGH'?.72:renderQuality==='MID'?.45:.24))spawnRaceParticle(p.x,p.y,'dust',1)}
 }
 for(let i=raceParticles.length-1;i>=0;i--){
  const p=raceParticles[i];p.x+=p.vx;p.y+=p.vy;p.vy+=.015;p.life-=p.type==='dust'?.022:.04;
  if(p.life<=0){raceParticles.splice(i,1);continue}
  c.globalAlpha=Math.max(0,p.life)*.32;c.fillStyle=p.type==='dust'?'#d5a763':'#dff8ff';c.beginPath();c.arc(p.x,p.y,p.size*p.life,0,Math.PI*2);c.fill()
 }
 c.restore();c.globalAlpha=1;
 raceRAF=requestAnimationFrame(drawCanvasTrack);
}
function startCanvasRace(){
 raceCanvasOn=true;raceParticles=[];resizeRaceCanvas();cancelAnimationFrame(raceRAF);drawCanvasTrack();
}
function stopCanvasRace(){raceCanvasOn=false;cancelAnimationFrame(raceRAF);raceParticles=[];if(raceCtx)raceCtx.clearRect(0,0,innerWidth,innerHeight)}
function canvasImpact(power=7){shakePower=Math.max(shakePower,power)}
function noise(ms=380,v=.02){if(!sound)return;ensureAudio();if(!audio)return;const n=Math.floor(audio.sampleRate*ms/1000),b=audio.createBuffer(1,n,audio.sampleRate),a=b.getChannelData(0);for(let i=0;i<n;i++)a[i]=(Math.random()*2-1)*(1-i/n);const s=audio.createBufferSource(),g=audio.createGain();s.buffer=b;g.gain.value=v;s.connect(g);g.connect(audio.destination);s.start()}
function speak(t,cut=true){
 if(!sound||!('speechSynthesis'in window))return;
 try{
  if(cut)speechSynthesis.cancel();
  const u=new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(t);
  u.lang='ja-JP';u.rate=ann.rate;u.pitch=ann.pitch;u.volume=1;
  speechSynthesis.speak(u);
 }catch(e){}
}
function sleep(ms){return new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms))}
let activeSpeechFinish=null;

 try{speechSynthesis?.cancel?.()}catch(e){}
 if(activeSpeechFinish){const f=activeSpeechFinish;activeSpeechFinish=null;try{f()}catch(e){}}
}
function speakFull(text,opts={}){
 return new Promise(resolve=>{
  if(!sound||!('speechSynthesis'in window)){setTimeout(resolve,Math.max(250,opts.silentMs||420));return}
  try{
   if(opts.cancel!==false)cancelNarrationNow();
   const u=new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
   u.lang='ja-JP';u.rate=opts.rate||ann.rate;u.pitch=opts.pitch||ann.pitch;u.volume=1;
   let done=false;
   const finish=()=>{if(done)return;done=true;clearTimeout(fallback);if(activeSpeechFinish===finish)activeSpeechFinish=null;resolve()};
